References discovered in the latest WhatsApp TestFlight version indicate that Meta is working on providing iPhone users with an alternative to iCloud backup. Details are as follows.

WhatsApp is developing its own backup service

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is developing its own cloud backup service for iPhone users, serving as an alternative to iCloud.

This feature has not yet been rolled out to WhatsApp TestFlight users, but WABetaInfo managed to activate an interface that lets users choose between iCloud and WhatsApp's own cloud service for backups. The interface promises 2GB of free storage, with paid plans reportedly offering up to 1TB of capacity.

The report also mentions that users can choose whether WhatsApp backups on iCloud are end-to-end encrypted, but for WhatsApp's own backup system, end-to-end encryption will be the default option.

From WABetaInfo's report:

Although there is no official timeline for the feature's release just yet, the report notes that WhatsApp is also developing an alternative to Google Drive backup for Android users. Given that work on both platforms is proceeding simultaneously, the feature may be officially announced in the near future.
